id: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby (2006)

facts.text: Whoever gets to the table first gets the biggest steak. I've been warming up in the car park.
facts.why: Ricky never says this. His real grace line on the quote page is 'I like the Christmas Jesus best, and I'm sayin' grace.'
facts.fix: Look, I like the Christmas Jesus best, and I'm sayin' grace.
